metadata.evidence: # CaLiGraph for Semantic Reasoning Evaluation Challenge

metadata.value:
This repository contains code and data to use [CaLiGraph](http://caligraph.org) as
a benchmark dataset in the [Semantic Reasoning Evaluation Challange](https://semrec.github.io)
at the [International Semantic Web Conference 2021 (ISWC'21)](https://iswc2021.semanticweb.org).

metadata.evidence:
The paper describing the dataset characteristics and results for well-known
reasoners can be found [here](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.05028.pdf).
metadata.reason: Link to the paper describing the dataset and baseline evaluation.

metadata.evidence: We use [CaLiGraph version 2.1.0](https://zenodo.org/record/5509912) as foundation for the challenge dataset.
metadata.reason: Identifies the foundational dataset used to build the challenge data.
Direct URL to the base dataset version on Zenodo.

metadata.evidence: In particular, we use the files `caligraph-ontology.nt.bz2` and `caligraph-instances_types.nt.bz2`
metadata.reason: Lists the exact data files used from CaLiGraph.

metadata.evidence: The datasets and all potentially inferrable assertions can be found [here](http://data.dws.informatik.uni-mannheim.de/CaLiGraph/CaLiGraph-for-SemREC/).
metadata.reason: Download link for sample datasets and inferred assertions.

metadata.evidence: To evaluate the reasoners, we used their connectors in [OWL API](https://github.com/owlcs/owlapi).
metadata.reason: Identifies the core API dependency used to connect reasoners.

metadata.evidence: The source code for the evaluation of the reasoners can be found in the folder `reasoner_evaluation`.

metadata.reason: CLI command to run reasoners via jar file.

metadata.evidence: we use the subsets `clg_10e4`, `clg_10e5`, and `clg_full` and split their inferrable assertions into training, validation, and test files.
metadata.reason: Identifies the subsets used in SemREC'22.

metadata.evidence: The split datasets can be found [here](http://data.dws.informatik.uni-mannheim.de/CaLiGraph/CaLiGraph-for-SemREC/SemREC-2022-Datasets/).
metadata.reason: URL to download SemREC'22 train/val/test split datasets.
